text:
One wakes to cannon fire

in the morning

full of airplanes

it would seem to be

the revolution

but it is the birthday

of the tyrant.

Ileana

the Andromeda galaxy,

700,000 light-years

which can be

seen with the naked eye

on a clear night

is closer than you

other solitary eyes are

looking at me from Andromeda,

in their night

I do not see you.

Ileana, distance is time,

and time flies.

At 200 million

miles per hour

the universe

is expanding

toward nothingness

and you are far

from me as if

millions of years away.

translation.title: Epigram XX
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the collision of tyrant's birthday spectacle with the Andromeda-distance love poem.
